56: def trim_beats(beats, min_beat_time=5.0):
57:     """Remove beats before min_beat_time.  A common preprocessing step.
58: 
59:     Parameters
60:     ----------
61:     beats : np.ndarray
62:         Array of beat times in seconds.
63:     min_beat_time : float
64:         Minimum beat time to allow
65:         (Default value = 5.)
66: 
67:     Returns
68:     -------
69:     beats_trimmed : np.ndarray
70:         Trimmed beat array.
71:     """
72:     # Remove beats before min_beat_time
73:     return beats[beats >= min_beat_time]
